title: One-dimensional boundary-term and trace estimate on an interval
statement: Let a < b be real and let φ, γ : ℝ → ℝ be C¹ functions with |γ(t)| ≤ 1 for all t. Then |∫_a^b (φγ)'(t) dt| ≤ (2/(b − a)) ∫_a^b |φ(t)| dt + 2 ∫_a^b |φ'(t)| dt, where ' denotes the derivative (deriv) and the integrals are interval integrals.
lean_statement: ∀ (φ γ : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → ContDiff ℝ 1 γ → (∀ t, |γ t| ≤ 1) → a < b → |∫ t in a..b, deriv (fun s => φ s * γ s) t| ≤ 2 / (b - a) * (∫ t in a..b, |φ t|) + 2 * ∫ t in a..b, |deriv φ t|
